name: The Pyramids
text: The Pyramids are three 11-story, pyramidal office buildings that are part of a 200-acre (810,000 m2) commercial development in the College Park neighborhood of Indianapolis, Indiana, United States. The structures occupy 40 acres (16 hectares) next to a 25-acre (10-hectare) lake. They were constructed between 1967 and 1972 by the College Life Insurance Company (now part of Americo Life) using a design by architect Kevin Roche.
